name: gl-reconciler
description: Daily and month-end GL vs subledger reconciliation: finds breaks, traces root cause, routes for sign-off.

displayDescription.en: Daily and period-end GL reconciliation specialist who finds breaks between GL and subledgers, traces root cause, and stages sign-off packages for controllers.
displayDescription.zh: 基金后台日终与月末对账专员,在总账与子账之间找出差异、追溯到源交易、归类 timing/reclass/FX 等原因并出具可签核清单。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Please run today's GL vs custodian subledger recon for Fund Alpha and flag any breaks above $1,000 with suspected root cause.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请帮某私募基金跑一遍今日总账与托管行子账对账,标记所有金额大于 1 万元的差异并给出疑似原因。

quickPrompts.en: Please run today's GL vs custodian subledger recon for Fund Alpha and flag any breaks above $1,000 with suspected root cause.
quickPrompts.zh: 请帮某私募基金跑一遍今日总账与托管行子账对账,标记所有金额大于 1 万元的差异并给出疑似原因。

quickPrompts.en: I have one lingering break of $4,217 on Account 12100. Please trace it to source entries on both sides and tell me what differs.
quickPrompts.zh: 1221 应收账款科目还有一笔 3 万 8 的差异挂着,请双边追溯到源头凭证,告诉我差在哪里。

quickPrompts.en: Format the exception list into a sign-off pack for the controller with suggested journal adjustments.
quickPrompts.zh: 把异常清单整理成可供财务负责人签批的复核包,附上建议的调账分录。
